Senior Software Engineer – API, microservices, integration platforms, and workflow orchestration.

Senior software engineer with 25+ years of experience designing and operating backend systems, REST APIs, and integration platforms at scale. p.strong: Author & Maintainer – API Workflow Orchestration PoC (tchatAPI)

li.p: Oct 2024 – Present
Designed and implemented an API workflow orchestration engine in Ballerina, executing typed and generic HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, PUT) defined as structured JSON workflows (“SchemedTalks”).
Exposed the orchestration engine via both CLI and OpenAPI/Swagger UI, enabling interactive execution and testing of complex API scenarios.
Implemented response memorization, JSONPath-based data extraction, and dynamic reuse of previous responses across workflow steps.
Integrated OpenAI API as a managed request type to demonstrate AI-assisted API workflows and dynamic content generation.
Demonstrates strong alignment with Canonical microservices expectations: API design, workflow orchestration, schema-driven contracts, observability, and developer-facing tooling.
Live SwaggerUI demo: http://www.tchatapi.org
Source code: https://github.com/sitedesc/bal_apps/tree/main/apps/chatapi
